title: Fluid Tooltip
description: Grouped tooltips with a deliberate first appearance and fast directional handoffs: moving between related controls glides one surface to the next.
docs:
Installed `FluidTooltip`. Import it from `@/components/ui/fluid-tooltip` and wrap related controls in one group: `FluidTooltip.Group` > `FluidTooltip.Root id` > `FluidTooltip.Trigger asChild` (your button) and `FluidTooltip.Content` (a short label).

The first tooltip waits `openDelay` (350 ms); moving to a neighbour glides the surface there and slides the label in from the side of travel. The API is the same on Base UI, Radix and React Aria. Colors are `--fluid-tooltip-surface`, `-label` and `-shadow`. Under reduced motion it appears and switches without movement.

Ported from Dinil-Thilakarathne/sona-ui (MIT, copyright 2026 Dinil Thilakarathne); the license text is in the file.

props.name: Group orientation
props.description: The axis of directional entry; vertical groups open on the inline-end side.

props.name: Group openDelay / closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before the first tooltip opens, and the grace before one closes.

props.name: Group disabled / className
props.description: Disables every trigger's tooltip; extra classes for the surface.

props.name: Root id
props.description: A stable id per tooltip (keys the handoff).

props.name: Trigger asChild / keepOpenOnClick
props.description: Use the child element as the trigger; keep the tooltip open when it is pressed.

props.name: Content showArrow / className
props.description: The arrow, and extra classes for this tooltip's surface.

a11y: Each trigger is described by its tooltip (aria-describedby, role=tooltip), as the WAI-ARIA tooltip pattern describes.
Opens on keyboard focus without the hover delay and closes with Escape; hover keeps the primitive's grace behaviour.
Keep the content a short, non-interactive label; icon-only triggers still need their own aria-label.
Reduced motion: no glide, scale or slide; the tooltip appears and changes in place.
